title: Custom Pickleball Jersey Shirt, Personalized Name and Number Tee, Pickleball Team Gift
description:
A jersey-style shirt with your name and favourite number. Eleven is the winning score, so it makes a fun default.

Who it's for:
- Teams, leagues and doubles pairs
- Birthday and club gifts
- Players who want their own number

About the design:
Arched surname, a huge lime number and a clean 'PICKLEBALL' line. Personalise the name (shown as JOHNSON) and the number (shown as 11).

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
